100: Quality of Service Packet Scheduler.  This component provides network traffic control, including rate-of-flow and prioritization services.
1002: The Pacer Flow performance counter set consists of flow statistics from the packet scheduler.
1006: The number of packets dropped by the packet scheduler.
1010: The number of packets which got scheduled in some way (rather than just being directly sent to the underlying miniport).
1014: The number of packets from this flow which have been sent.
1018: The number of bytes which got scheduled in some way (rather than just being directly sent to the underlying miniport).
1022: The number of bytes from this flow which have been sent.
1026: The number of bytes per second from this flow which have been sent.
1030: The number of bytes per second from this flow which have been scheduled.
1034: The number of packets per second from this flow which have been sent.
1038: The number of packets per second from this flow which have been scheduled.
1042: The number of packets dropped by the packet scheduler from this flow per second.
1046: The number of packets that have entered the packet scheduler at a rate which exceeded the flow parameters.
1050: The rate at which nonconforming packets have entered the packet scheduler.
1054: The average number of packets in the shaper over the last sampling period.
1058: The maximum number of packets that have ever simultaneously been in the shaper.
1062: The average number of packets in the sequencer over the last sampling period.
1066: The maximum number of packets that have ever simultaneously been in the sequencer.
1070: The maximum number of packets that have been queued in the netcard by this flow.
1074: The average number of packets that have been queued in the netcard by this flow.
1078: The number of packets that have been sent by the packet scheduler at a rate which exceeded the flow parameters.
1082: The rate at which nonconforming packets have been sent by the packet scheduler.
1086: The Pacer Pipe performance counter set consists of pipe statistics from the packet scheduler.
1090: The number of times Pacer has been unable to allocate a packet.
1094: The number of flows opened on this pipe (some of which may now be closed).
1098: The number of flows that have been closed.
1102: The number of flow creations that were rejected.
1106: The number of times a flow has been modified.
1110: The number of times a flow modification has been rejected.
1114: The maximum number of flows that have been simultaneously open on this pipe.
1118: The number of packets that have entered the packet scheduler at a rate which exceeded that packet's flow parameters.
1122: The rate at which nonconforming packets have entered the packet scheduler.
1126: The average number of packets in the shaper over the last sampling period.
1130: The maximum number of packets that have ever simultaneously been in the shaper.
1134: The average number of packets in the sequencer over the last sampling period.
1138: The maximum number of packets that have ever simultaneously been in the sequencer.
1142: The maximum number of packets ever simultaneously in the network card.
1146: The average number of packets in the network card over the last sampling period.
1150: The number of packets that have been sent by the packet scheduler at a rate which exceeded that packet's flow parameters.
1154: The rate at which nonconforming packets have been sent by the packet scheduler.
